steps: Others: A false, B false (equal at 45), D false
check_code:
import math
def f(k,t):
    s,c=math.sin(math.radians(t)),math.cos(math.radians(t))
    return {'A':s<c,'B':abs(s-c)>1e-9,'C':s<c,'D':s>c}[k]
A=all(f('A',t) for t in (50,60,80))
B=f('B',45)
C=all(f('C',t) for t in (10,30,44))
D=all(f('D',t) for t in (10,30,44))
assert C and not A and not B and not D
